items.title: John L. Jones Interview, 1972-06-05
items.q: That's the last letter I got from him.

ctx.x: How did you happen to get tied up with David Griffiths? You know, you wrote that thing on you once.

You, uh, uh, uh, I was recommended to David Griffiths by somebody, somebody left here and went to Europe. Mm-hmm. Some, some music, old musician left here. Mm-hmm. And went to, went to Europe and gave him my name. Because I've never seen him. I've never seen him here.

Oh, yeah. Did you ever see his magazine on the Jazz? I know he should write up on different bands. Mm-hmm. One of the best magazines ever saw, you know, because he tells you the story of the mental. He's still writing? New Orleans Jazz, right? No.
